language: Python 3.11.4+ (CI runs 3.14), with a POSIX sh bootstrap
summary: depot is qq, the one command line a contributor puts on their PATH to fetch a repo's toolchains, build and test it the way CI does, and send changes through the gate. It exists so every repo runs exactly the qq version its manifest pins, and so long-running work like CI never ties up the caller.

how_it_works.title: Self-pinning bootstrap
how_it_works.text: bin/qq checks for Python 3.11.4 or newer and hands off to a launcher that reads the current repo's [qq] pin through qqsync. The first run installs that version into its own environment under $QQ_HOME, and later runs reuse it, so moving the pin is how qq updates.

how_it_works.title: qq sync fills a sealed store
how_it_works.text: Each toolchain and dependency pin is fetched once per machine into $QQ_HOME/store, checked against its digest, unpacked if it is a tarball and made read only. Every later sync checks the entry is unchanged before linking it into <repo>/.qq/toolchains or <repo>/.qq/deps.

how_it_works.title: qq build and qq test run recipes locally
how_it_works.text: Both commands hand the manifest to recipes, which plans and runs each action and leaves JUnit XML and results.json under .qq/out. Product CI does not run through recipes yet; depot's presubmit parity job shows qq test and qqrecipes execute give the same JUnit.

how_it_works.title: Acknowledge, then push
how_it_works.text: qq try and qq land return a run ID at once and start a detached watcher. The watcher polls the change and writes the final verdict to $QQ_HOME/verdicts/<run ID>.json and to an optional --notify command.

how_it_works.title: Land only after the gate passes
how_it_works.text: qq land asks the pinned qqgate for a verdict first and refuses a change the gate refused. Only after a pass does it call gh pr merge with --auto and --match-head-commit, which enters the merge queue where the repo has one.

key_files.what: The shell entry point you put on PATH; checks Python and starts the bootstrap.
Reads the repo's [qq] pin and installs or runs exactly that version from a trusted source.
Content-addressed, read-only store for fetched toolchains and dependencies.
qq upload, try, land and status.
Thin wrappers over the gh command line for the GitHub backend.
Runs quirq-ai/gate's qqgate at a pinned commit to get required checks and verdicts.

status.text: The v0 items for version pinning, qq fetch and qq sync, qq build and qq test, and qq upload, try, land and status are all marked merged.
Presubmit shows try and land end to end with a fake gh, and runs qq status read-only through the real gh.
Presubmit's parity job builds xo-space and innernet with sync's fixture manifests rather than the manifests those repos carry.
The watcher polls the backend every 30 seconds by default and gives up after 3 hours; replacing polling with events is an open TODO.
